limitations: Two fixed ordinary generated pairs, two execution seeds: descriptive stress coverage, not NFL frequencies or a representative league estimate.
PA pair changes the existing generic OL run show plus QB/RB fake and its protection availability; later execution draws need not stay matched.
Native fake scheme tags are aliases, not different run-line, pull, slice, fake-pitch or boot installations.
A loaded first-contact defender or unachieved second-level job is an investigation flag, not a demonstrated controller error.
20-second live endings are censored, excluded from terminal gain/success statistics.
Opening clocks use exact saved1/2s states; .5s was bracketed by .4/.6s sampling and is not interpolated.
